text:
```yaml
name: Portability Validation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - qumun/**
      - main.go
      - Makefile

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        kernel-version: ['6.12.2', '6.13', '6.14', '6.15', '6.16', '6.17']
      fail-fast: false

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build project
        run: make KERNEL_VERSION=${{ matrix.kernel-version }}

      - name: Run tests
        run: make test KERNEL_VERSION=${{ matrix.kernel-version }}
```
